records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Our sales are typically higher in our second quarter, which usually includes our Anniversary Sale, and the holidays in the fourth quarter.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Revenues recognized from our beginning contract liability balance were $114 for the quarter ended May 1, 2021 and $130 for the quarter ended May 2, 2020.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: We had $707 remaining in share repurchase capacity as of May 1, 2021.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net loss for the first quarter was $166, or $1.05 per diluted share, including an after-tax debt refinancing charge of $0.41.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: First quarter net sales increased 44% from the same period in 2020 and decreased 13% from the same period in 2019, representing a sequential improvement of 720 basis points relative to the fourth quarter of 2020.
